## 📌 Description
Integrate Allure Report framework, attach screenshots, logs, execution metadata, and automatically publish reports in CI.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **Allure Dependencies**
- Add `allure-testng` and `aspectjweaver` to `pom.xml`
- Configure Surefire to use Allure listener

- [ ] **Allure Annotations**
- Annotate test classes with `@Epic`, `@Feature`, `@Story`
- Use `@Step` for page object methods
- Attach screenshots via `Allure.addAttachment()` on failure

- [ ] **CI Publishing**
- After `mvn test`, run `allure generate` and `allure open`
- Upload Allure history as artifact
- Optionally deploy to GitHub Pages or use Allure Docker service

- [ ] **Rich Attachments**
- Attach network logs, console logs, and video (if implemented)
- Environment info (browser, OS, Java version) displayed in report overview

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Allure report shows test steps, parameters, and attachments for both passed and failed tests
- [ ] Screenshots are embedded inline for failures
- [ ] Report is automatically generated in CI and downloadable as an artifact

## 📎 Dependencies
- [ ] v0.8.0 (Retry & Listeners) complete

## 🧪 Validation
- [ ] Run `mvn clean test` → `allure-report/` generated
- [ ] Open `index.html` – verify attachments and steps
- [ ] CI pipeline includes the allure step and does not break on report generation
